method: Every final PNG was opened and inspected directly after the final capture run; active-route visibility is also asserted from real browser geometry.
resolvedRejections: Full-page captures now begin at the page origin and no longer place the sticky Life command strip over the page title.
All four data tabs remain visible at phone widths and 200% zoom, including the active Obsidian tab.
The active Life route is centered inside its horizontal navigation after viewport or zoom geometry changes; 390 px, 320 px and 200% browser assertions verify it remains visible.
History Back restores focus to the data-management heading after browser focus restoration settles.

groups.notes: Desktop and tablet retain a readable side-by-side comparison rhythm; phone and 200% zoom collapse to a continuous single column with clear conflict choices, recipe-version gating, bounded actions and no page-level horizontal overflow. Reduced motion preserves identical state and hierarchy.

The disconnected state stays bounded to the integration panel, uses an explicit degraded label and diagnostic, and leaves the surrounding MySQL-backed data workspace available without invented connection status.
